justification: Names the Reflexion episodic-memory loop carrying reflections of failed interventions across anomalies as its central contribution, credited by an ablation; a proposed architecture tried only in ns-3 simulation, never on a live network.

Contribution is an explicit agent state with update rules and typed interfaces that fix the next tool step; a prototype assistant exercised on one lab ocean-circulation case study, not in operational science practice.

Argues vector-DB retrieval is the wrong working memory for agents, citing no importance flagging, no retrieval-reasoning feedback and no time decay; a stated position with no method, system or evaluation offered.

Headline artefacts are a measurement instrument, a curated single-vulnerability privesc benchmark plus the hackingBuddyGPT harness, used to measure several LLMs on VMs in the lab against human tester baselines.

Contribution is a homeostatic control layer whose Competence/Connection/Necessity drive vectors and executive module select the next action; two agent instances from an identical baseline are run with differing interlocutors and compared.

Contribution is a deterministic validation layer that gates LLM proposals by P&ID graph traversal before execution; evaluated on Tennessee Eastman benchmark-derived and synthetic scenarios in the lab, not in a running plant.

Abstract states external verifiers gate both action release and memory updates before execution; a plug-in module measured on eight CWE secure-code-generation scenarios across four LLMs in the lab, no deployed use reported.

Argues genuine agency requires internalized identity evolution, learned self-regulation and self-directed learning from experience rather than external scaffolding; a conceptual agentic/agentive distinction and architecture, no study.

Contribution is typed persistent state carrying experiment history across iterations so history is not re-read, cutting tokens 90%/52%; stateful and stateless variants run on two lab task sets for comparison.

Formalizes guard functions that verify post-conditions and admit or reject each LLM step, with proven failure bounds; validated in the lab on 13 models, three diagnostic probes and 99 SWE-Bench Pro instance-arm pairs.

Contribution replaces the MAPE-K loop's stages with an Assess-Weigh-Act-Reflect-Enrich cycle fixing what the adaptation loop does next; argued through a comparison with MAPE-K and one demonstrative use case, no measurement.

Contribution assembles the pipeline of steps to satisfy an intent, selecting actions via a Bayesian contextual-bandit over a retrieval-augmented LLM; measured against baseline LLMs in a cyber-physical testbed, not in a factory.

Presents a self-correcting framework whose claim is the iterative plan-act-reflect-revise cycle rewriting failed simulation code; run on twelve constructed tasks against GPT and human-in-the-loop baselines in the lab.

Contribution is a dynamic memory workspace that consolidates retrieved evidence into a global memory pool across reasoning cycles; measured on four pre-existing 200K-token narrative benchmarks against RAG baselines.

Contribution is an instrument for governing evaluation of agent loops, a process model and reference architecture unifying offline and online evaluation, synthesised from a multivocal literature review with no study of its use.

Contribution is interleaving reasoning traces with actions so the trace induces, tracks and updates the plan and decides the next step; a new prompting technique measured in the lab on HotpotQA, Fever, ALFWorld and WebShop.

An empirical audit of one named mechanism, ReAct's interleaving of reasoning and action, finding the interleaving and trace content barely matter; systematic prompt variations are introduced as a lab sensitivity analysis.

Contribution is an in-context algorithm that re-attempts a failed task by self-correcting the previous attempt; lab runs on six text-game tasks compare first attempt against the self-corrected retry, two of six then solved.

Contribution is an outer loop where a reflector critiques and an optimizer rewrites the agent's action principles from its own trajectories via text gradients; measured in the lab across four agent environments.

Object is the missing pre-execution check: agents seldom re-evaluate an action once it enters the thought, and the mitigation is a reflection step reassessing action safety; benign injected requests varied in lab attacks.

Models solving as a calibrated stopped process bounding false-admission risk, instantiated as dual-granularity verification and test augmentation deciding when a program is admitted; measured on LiveCodeBench Pro and ICPC-Eval.

Contribution is team composition itself, a graph of pairwise-conversation coherence plus community detection choosing which models collaborate; teams measured on downstream benchmarks against random and curated baselines.

Contribution is continual strategy evolution without fine-tuning, external latent vectors updated by reflection and reward across episodes; lab multi-round interaction runs track latent convergence under those updates.

Contribution P-ReAct restructures the reason-act interleaving so tool_call tokens decode first and thinking continues during the tool wait; a post-trained dLLM agent measured in the lab against mainstream search agents.

Contribution is uncertainty quantification judging whether the agent may answer unaided or must query the world, cutting tool calls; measured in the lab on HotpotQA, StrategyQA and MMLU across LLM sizes.
